name: rhun
description: Build, test and release extensions for the rhun editor in Rust, Go, C or C++.

interface.longDescription: Write, test and publish extensions for the rhun editor in Rust, Go, C or C++, with protocol 1.1 (rhun 0.18): commands with keys, menus and status items, workspace edits, snippets, views, every language feature, decorations, tasks, debuggers, test controllers, source control, notebooks, custom editors, agents and tools.
defaultPrompt: Write a rhun extension in Rust that charts my project
Add completion to my rhun extension
Test my rhun extension with the conformance checker
